messages:
Aaron Holt: Starting a micro PR to refresh the 'Hello Starter' quickstart. Scope: show CLI-first auth, add a tiny migration note for model alias rename, tighten the minimal deploy example to a single `docker run` variant, and correct two links that point to an old /guides path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4955
Nina Gupta: Love CLI-first. Can we also include the one-liner for setting the env var for folks on CI (but tucked under an "Advanced" collapsible)?
Aaron Holt: Yes 0pct. Plan: top of page has `redwood login --api-key <KEY>` then a small expandable panel titled "CI / env var" with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`.
Marta (Docs): Please add a 1-line note about API key scoping (user vs org) so readers don't expect cross-account tokens to work. Also the pricing/rate-limit sentence in the quickstart reads too casual: "no limits". Can we change to "soft limits on free tier" and link to pricing?
Aaron Holt: Done. Updated wording to "soft rate limits on free tier; see pricing" and added the canonical pricing link. Fixed the two bad /guides anchors to the new /learn/ paths.
Nina Gupta: The Python snippet forgets to show region-specific client init for EU customers. Could you add `client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")` as a small inline example?
Aaron Holt: Added both `RedwoodClient()` and `RedwoodClient(region=\"eu-west-1\")` variants. Also added a tiny grep/sed migration helper for repos still referencing `helium-v1`: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and a macOS-safe `perl -pi -e` alternative.
Marta (Docs): UX nit: can we make the Docker example use `node:18-slim` and show an optional Alpine form? Some enterprise customers flagged full `node:18` earlier.
Aaron Holt: Swapped to `node:18-slim` in the primary Dockerfile and appended an alpine variant. Also reduced the deploy steps to 3 concise bullets so the page feels lighter.
build-bot: Preview build started for PR 4955 680 (preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/hello-starter/preview)
Nina Gupta: Quick request 5%: add a single debugging curl command for auth checks, eg `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` to help new devs.
Aaron Holt: Done. Also added a one-line troubleshooting note about clock skew causing 401s.
build-bot: Build succeeded: docs-ci/preview/4955 44fb (staging preview live)
Marta (Docs): Reviewed, left two tiny style nits (heading depth + a phrasing tweak). Once those are fixed I'm happy to approve.
Aaron Holt: Addressed nits and pushed. Will merge after scheduled docs deploy window. Thanks team! :shipit:
